scope.audience: Upper-division undergraduate computer science students, early graduate students, and practicing developers moving into architecture work.
scope.workload: Designed as a 3-credit college course with weekly reading, architecture studios, quizzes, and a capstone architecture package.
prerequisites: Familiarity with web or enterprise application development
scope.outcome: Students can define, document, communicate, and evaluate software architecture using stakeholder concerns, viewpoints, views, perspectives, scenarios, and tradeoff reasoning.
